doc: User-mediated files (LCP-017). Selection is the browser's: a real <input type=file data-files-input="name"> that the user operates, reported as a Selected fact with opaque file ids and metadata — never a File object, never a path. The engine may ask to open that input's picker, which the browser permits only during user activation. Reads are bounded slices, so a large file is read in chunks and never loaded whole. There is no filesystem browsing and no hidden upload.

constants.name: MAX_READ_BYTES
constants.doc: The largest single read, in bytes.

types.name: FileInput
types.doc: An <input type=file> named in HTML by data-files-input; key selects a row by the nearest data-files-key ancestor.

types.name: FileId
types.doc: Opaque; issued by this page's pack and meaningless anywhere else.

types.name: ReadFormat
types.doc: text decodes UTF-8 (a slice that splits a character decodes it as U+FFFD); base64 carries bytes exactly.

types.name: FileInfo
types.doc: What the browser says about a selected file. name is the file name only, never a path; type is the browser's guess and may be empty.

variants.name: pick
variants.doc: Open the named input's picker. Browsers allow this only during user activation, which an engine round trip may outlast; NeedsGesture then says the user must operate the input itself. A selection arrives as a Selected fact, a dismissal as PickerCancelled.

variants.name: read
variants.doc: Read length bytes (1 to MAX_READ_BYTES) from offset. A read past the end returns what there is, with eof.

variants.name: release
variants.doc: Forget a file id. The pack keeps a selected file readable until the engine releases it or the page unloads.

variants.name: download
variants.doc: Offer data to the user as a download named fileName. data is text or base64 per format, at most MAX_READ_BYTES once decoded.

variants.name: Downloaded
variants.doc: The browser was handed the download; whether the user kept it is not observable.

variants.name: NeedsGesture
variants.doc: The browser refused to open a picker without user activation.

variants.name: WrongElement
variants.doc: The target is not an <input type=file>.

variants.name: InvalidRange
variants.doc: offset is negative, or length is below 1.

variants.name: InvalidData
variants.doc: download data is not valid base64.

variants.name: Unreadable
variants.doc: The browser could not read the file (it changed, moved, or permission was lost). The exception's name only.

variants.name: Refused
variants.doc: The browser refused for another reason (for example a disabled input, or a picker in a cross-origin frame). The exception's name only.

variants.name: Selected
variants.doc: The user chose files with the named input: one, or several if the input allows multiple. Earlier ids stay valid until released.

variants.name: PickerCancelled
variants.doc: The user dismissed the picker without changing the selection.
